description: This file is a server-side route module for handling lead data in a CRM application built with SvelteKit. It includes data fetching, CRUD operations, lead conversion, duplication, status updates, and fetching individual lead details from a Django REST API backend. The code manages API interactions, data transformations, and request handling for the lead-related pages.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads leads data, tags, users, teams, contacts, and related info based on URL parameters and view mode (table or kanban). It processes API responses, transforms lead data for frontend use, and returns structured data for page rendering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of new lead entries by parsing form data, validating mandatory fields, preparing payload, and sending POST requests to the Django API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing lead by parsing form data, validating, preparing data payload, and sending PATCH requests with lead ID to the backend.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a lead specified by ID through a DELETE request to the API.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Marks a lead as converted by updating its status to 'converted' via PATCH request.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing lead by fetching the lead data, modifying the title, and sending a POST request to create a new lead with copied data.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the lead's status (used in kanban view) via a PATCH request to move the lead to a new status column.

methods.name: getLead
methods.description: Fetches detailed info of a single lead for kanban card display, transforming backend data into frontend format and normalizing status field.
